weaknesses.title: ENV SET is process-local only — parent shell unchanged after exit
weaknesses.detail: SYS ENV SET CUBALC_P2P_SOFT works for same-process DIAL (closes prior shell-export gap) but does not persist to the invoking shell. Follow-on shell cubalc runs still need host export unless each program re-SET. Documented parent soft=unset after run.
weaknesses.repro: Program ENV SETs soft; after exit echo $CUBALC_P2P_SOFT still empty

weaknesses.title: WORDS is whitespace-only — comma peer lists stay one token
weaknesses.detail: SYS WORDS '127.0.0.1:1,127.0.0.1:2' → 1 field. Agents must SPLIT ',' first or use spaces. Easy misconfig for CSV-style peer env.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON / plate strings still collapse newlines in multi-line bags
weaknesses.detail: REVL of a\nb\nc shows as 'cba' in PRINT_JSON LAST (newlines lost). Same class as VARS collapse — agents re-parsing JSON strings cannot recover bag structure.
weaknesses.repro:
SYS REVL a
b
c; PRINT_JSON LAST → cba without

weaknesses.title: Soft dial still emits FAIL sticky — must CLEAR_ERR per peer for -s
weaknesses.detail: Intentional soft miss uses FAIL then CLEAR_ERR. Forgetting CLEAR_ERR fails entire fanout under -s after first dead peer.
weaknesses.repro: SMX DIAL dead peer with SOFT; omit CLEAR_ERR; run -s → ok=false

weaknesses.title: Comments in .cubalc source are not free-form English sentences
weaknesses.detail: Inline comment lines without # can parse as forms (unknown form 'not'). Agents writing prose comments mid-program break runs. Prefer // or # comment style only.
weaknesses.repro: Line 'unset is not available' → unknown form 'not'

workarounds: ENV SET CUBALC_P2P_SOFT 1 and TIMEOUT at start of every dial program
Use space-separated peer lists or SPLIT ',' before WORDS
Use PRINT_JSON scalar counts not multi-line bag strings
CLEAR_ERR after every intentional soft FAIL/DIAL miss under -s
Only // or # comments in program bodies
language_gaps: Optional persist-env / dotenv plate for multi-process agents
WORDS with custom sep or auto CSV split
JSON string escape of newlines in PRINT_JSON/VARS
Soft dial without FAIL sticky (SMX_OK-only probe form)
